g.text: frac_still (time immobile / trial duration) by condition × sex
Grain: animal × session × trial. Point = frac_still = time_immobile_s / duration_s from IMPRESS ambulation (fore displacement
hysteresis). No across-model whiskers (single ambulation clock). Six violins = condition × sex (F then M). Kruskal within sex; * =
BH q < 0.05 in the 24-cell family. Not cluster-13 frame share; not paired Δ; not Wilcoxon vs 0.
